_doc: Standing collection requirements for Hungary's region. Shown on Command Brief page 2 when a priority country has no material development this week: gap -> intelligence question -> desired observable. Edit freely; one entry per country.

srb.question: Has Serbia changed its fighter procurement, readiness, basing or exercise activity (Rafale introduction, MiG-29 status)?
srb.observable: Rafale delivery or training milestones, MiG-29 grounding or upgrade news, Serbian Air Force exercise announcements.

blr.question: Has Russian aviation basing or deployment in Belarus changed?
blr.observable: Russian combat aircraft or air defence units arriving at or leaving Belarusian air bases; joint exercise announcements.

rus.question: Has Russian air posture opposite NATO's eastern flank changed (basing, readiness, losses, new types)?
rus.observable: Redeployments to western military districts, new type deliveries, attributed losses, long-range aviation activity near NATO airspace.

ukr.question: How is Ukraine's Western fighter fleet (F-16, Mirage 2000, future Gripen/Rafale) being generated and sustained?
ukr.observable: Delivery, training or loss announcements by the Ukrainian Air Force; donor-state statements.

rou.question: Has Romania's F-16 readiness, F-35 transition or NATO basing changed?
rou.observable: F-35 programme milestones, F-16 deliveries from Norway, Allied deployments to Romanian bases, air defence integration news.

svk.question: Is Slovakia's F-16 fleet operational for QRA, and who covers its airspace?
svk.observable: Slovak F-16 operational declaration, QRA assumption, end of Allied cover arrangements.

hrv.question: What is the readiness of Croatia's Rafale fleet and its role in regional air policing?
hrv.observable: Rafale FOC or QRA announcements, regional air policing agreements.

svn.question: Has the Allied arrangement for Slovenian air policing changed?
svn.observable: Statements on Italian/Hungarian air policing of Slovenia; Slovenian air defence procurement.

aut.question: Has Austria moved on Eurofighter succession, trainer replacement or Sky Shield integration?
aut.observable: Bundesheer procurement decisions, Sky Shield participation steps, air policing statements.

bih.question: Is there any change in Bosnia and Herzegovina's air force or EUFOR air activity?
bih.observable: Helicopter procurement or donation news, EUFOR exercise announcements.

pol.question: How is Poland's air force build-up (F-35, FA-50, AH-64E, air defence) progressing against plan?
pol.observable: Deliveries, IOC/FOC declarations, Allied deployments to Polish bases.

cze.question: Has the Czech transition from Gripen to F-35 changed schedule or scope?
cze.observable: F-35 programme milestones, Gripen lease decisions.

bgr.question: Is Bulgaria's F-16 Block 70 introduction on track, and has Black Sea air policing changed?
bgr.observable: F-16 deliveries, Allied air policing rotations.

est.question: Has Baltic air policing or Estonian air defence changed?
est.observable: BAP rotation changes, Ämari deployments, air defence procurement.

lva.question: Has Baltic air policing or Latvian air defence changed?
lva.observable: BAP rotation changes, air defence procurement.

ltu.question: Has Baltic air policing or Lithuanian air defence changed?
ltu.observable: BAP rotation changes at Šiauliai, air defence procurement.

hun.question: Have MH air capability programmes (Gripen, KC-390, H145M/H225M, L-39NG, air defence) passed a milestone?
hun.observable: Deliveries, IOC statements and procurement decisions published by the Hungarian MoD.
